answer_strings: Hillary Clinton has never served as the President of the United States. She did, however, have a significant political career as the First Lady of the United States (1993-2001), U.S. Senator from New York (2001-2009), and the U.S. Secretary of State (2009-2013). Additionally, she was the Democratic Party's nominee for the presidency in 2016 but lost the election to Donald Trump.
